scenes.headline: How an omni model decides what to watch
scenes.sub: Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash: text, image, audio and video in, a 1M-token context.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Sprocket! Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash reads text, images, audio and video. Its real news is that it doesn't watch the whole video.

scenes.text: Instead of ingesting a whole recording, the model starts from the question and decides what to watch and listen to, coarse to fine.
scenes.mark: decides what to watch and listen to
scenes.say: Instead of ingesting a whole recording, the model starts from the question, and decides for itself what to watch and listen to.

scenes.title: Two ways to read a long video

left.title: Static ingestion
items: Samples the whole file at a fixed rate
Cost grows in step with video length
left.say: Static ingestion samples the whole file at a fixed rate, so cost grows with video length.

right.title: Agentic perception
items: Plans what to sample, one call at a time
right.say: Agentic perception plans what to sample, one function call at a time, conditioned on the question.

steps.say: It begins with the question, and picks a stretch of the recording to look at.
Only that span is sampled, frames and sound, and what it finds is kept as evidence.

steps.note: multiple rounds of coarse-to-fine evidence gathering
steps.say: If that isn't enough, it zooms in and looks again, round after round, coarse to fine.
When the evidence answers the question, it stops. Most of the video is never read.

scenes.label: fewer tokens on OmniVideoBench, while accuracy rose from 63.4 to 67.8
scenes.note: Qwen's own table: 145,736 tokens down to 79,117
scenes.say: On OmniVideoBench, that spent forty-five point seven percent fewer tokens, and accuracy rose from sixty-three point four to sixty-seven point eight.

scenes.title: The realtime model: listen, think, talk

steps.say: A live stream goes two ways: a vision encoder, and Spatial AuT, a new audio transformer that locates targets by sound.
Both feed the Thinker, which reasons and writes text. Its wait grows as the input gets longer.

steps.note: about a second to the first audio packet
steps.say: A separate Talker speaks the text. In Qwen's latency table, that stage adds a near-fixed three hundred fifty-six to four hundred eight milliseconds.

scenes.text: Choosing what to watch isn't a quality-for-speed trade. On this benchmark it was cheaper and more accurate at once.

recap: Start from the question, not the recording
Spatial AuT listens, Thinker reasons, Talker speaks
scenes.say: To recap: start from the question, zoom in only where needed, and split thinking from talking.
